Good evening. How can I help you?
Good evening. I need something for a fever.
Is it for you?
No, it is for my daughter. She is six years old, twenty kilos, and she has thirty-eight now.
Perfect, that is exactly what I need to know. This one is for children from two to twelve.
Is it safe with a nut allergy? My son is allergic, and sometimes they share.
Good question. This one has no nuts. I would avoid the chewable ones, though, just in case.
Sorry, I don't understand. Can you say that again, more slowly?
Sorry. Not the ones you chew. Take the liquid.
The liquid, thank you. And I need a box of plasters too.
Here. Anything else?
One more thing. How often can I give it to her?
Every six hours, four times a day maximum. If the fever is still there tomorrow, see a doctor.
Two bottles of water and a packet of biscuits, please.

Thank you for calling. Please listen carefully, because our hours change at night. We are open from eight in the morning until ten at night, every day including Sunday. After ten, the nearest night pharmacy is on King Road, next to the station, and it is open all night. For medicine for children, please come to the counter and tell us three things: who it is for, the age, and the weight if you know it. That is what we need to give you the right one. If your child has any allergy, please tell us before we give you anything. We cannot give some medicines without a prescription from a doctor, but for a fever, a headache or a small cut, you do not need one. If it is an emergency, do not wait: call one one one, or go to the hospital on Green Street. Thank you.

Good evening, shoppers. The supermarket closes in twenty minutes, so please come to the tills soon. A few things before you go. The fresh bread and the cakes are half price after nine, and they are at the back, near the milk. If you need water, the big six-bottle packs are on offer tonight, two packs for five pounds. The pharmacy counter inside the shop is now closed, but the shop next door is open until ten. And a note for parents: we have a new line of biscuits with no nuts and no milk, and you find them on the second shelf, in the blue boxes. Please bring your basket to the till and not to the door. Thank you for shopping with us, and good night.
Good evening. I need something for a fever. It is for my daughter, she is six years old. Is it safe with a nut allergy? How often can I give it to her? Thank you very much.
